class.name: CASLayoutProvider
class.brief_description: Computes how files are split into chunks in GCAS packages.
class.description: Extend this class to control how files are stored in GCAS packages, for example to split files at the boundaries of the data read by streaming. Register providers with [method GCASPacker.add_layout_provider], or with [method GCASPacker.add_export_layout_provider] to use them when exporting projects.

method.name: _get_layout
method.description: Returns the layout of the file at [param path], with contents [param data]. Returns [code]null[/code] to use the default layout.

method.name: _get_provider_name
method.description: Returns the name of the provider, which identifies its layout hints in packages. It must not change between versions.

method.name: _handles_file
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the provider computes the layout of the file at [param path].
